'''Chian Kee''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2002 Melbourne tournament]] on 6 January 2002 with Lightsaber Combat, according to Luca Costanzo's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3249">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-09-melbourne-oz-06-01-2k2d3249/ melbourne-oz-06-01-2k2], DeckTech (Luca "Luca/Tzizvvt" Costanzo, 9 January 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-09-melbourne-oz-06-01-2k2d3249/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
